title: This week in science: anxiety in college students, potatoes on the moon and whale snot
summary: Science reporters Nate Rott and Sanden Totten talk about the growing risk of anxiety among college students, a simulation of growing potatoes on the Moon, and the genetic secrets in whale snot.
